home.servicesSubtitle: Specialized solutions tailored to your needs
home.whyUsSubtitle: An independent consultancy committed to accuracy, transparency, and real support
home.whyUs1Body: Calibration and quality control with over 99.99% accuracy, in accordance with ISO/IEC 17025 standards.
home.whyUs2Body: Operating under the supervision of Iran's Food & Drug Organization and Atomic Energy Organization, with recognized international accreditations.
home.whyUs3Body: Our technical team is ready to provide calibration services at your hospital, laboratory, or factory.
home.whyUs4Body: As an independent consultancy, we put your interests first — not the sale of specific equipment.
home.processSubtitle: From your first request to the final report, in four transparent steps
home.process1Body: Fill out the consultation form or call our specialists so we can understand your needs.
home.process2Body: Our experts assess your equipment and the relevant standard requirements, then plan the work.
home.process3Body: Calibration or quality control is carried out on-site or in our lab with over 99.99% accuracy.
home.process4Body: A complete, documented report matching the applicable standard is delivered along with your certificate.

about.title: About Persia Azma System
about.subtitle: Your independent partner in precision and quality
about.introBody: As an independent consultancy, Persia Azma System provides calibration and quality-control services for medical, imaging, industrial, and laboratory equipment with over 99.99% accuracy — for hospitals, clinics, and industry. We help our clients make informed decisions about purchasing and operating their equipment.
about.missionBody: Our mission is to provide complete, focused solutions that ensure the safe, accurate, and cost-effective performance of medical and industrial equipment — through rigorous technical analysis, expert consulting, and operating-cost reduction, without ever compromising quality or safety.
about.locationBody: Persia Azma System's headquarters is located at the Fars Science & Technology Park in Shiraz, and our technical team is ready to provide on-site services at hospitals, laboratories, and factories across the country.
